_note: Research demonstrator — not a medical device. Power and cost ASSUMPTIONS for the battery budget, all PLACEHOLDER. They are rough figures of the right order for a small wearable with an Iridium 9603-class modem, from the builder's general knowledge and not checked against datasheets. The report compares policies; it is not a battery-life promise. Replace with measured values (D-22).

baseline_ma.note: always-on average: processor mostly asleep + vitals sensing + ISF patch reader

gps_fix_mas.note: one GPS fix attempt, ~30 mA for ~15 s (longer and often failing under canopy)

signal_check_mas.note: power up the modem and read signal bars, ~40 mA for ~10 s

send_attempt_mas.note: one send session, ~150 mA for ~30 s whether or not it succeeds
